title: Unify ordinary TermAl session sending with federated mailbox routing
outcome: Unify ordinary TermAl session sending with federated mailbox routing
acceptance: Ordinary termal_send_to_session accepts an enrolled remote-proxy destination and routes it through the existing federated delivery path.
The local-root-only precondition no longer blocks a valid federated destination before routing.
One shared delivery/routing implementation serves local and federated sends; no parallel public or manually invoked send path remains.
Focused regression tests cover local delivery and a remote-proxy/federated destination.
disposal_reason: Misfiled in the Engram tracker (Advisor #2065). This is TermAl code; it moved to TermAl P0 w-9b6940770927 (rev 2 carries all four of these criteria plus Greg's live Windows/Mac acceptance from #1890). Owner Termal::Sol-edfd, after w-d5e10300b0df. Fable2 ebe242f7 #4576.
